entries.title: A fourth panel on one side now shows
entries.body: Each side of the window held three panels and quietly left out the next one, so a panel of yours could go missing, and asking Firstmate to move a panel to a full side was refused. Both sides now show every panel placed on them, and open panels share the height and scroll.

picture.alt: The right side of the window with a Tokyo clock panel showing under the Reports panel
